title: finding: no state expresses "card is done, its PR is blocked by a gate defect that is not this card's"
body:
Departure-report **category ① (原则错/缺)** from the `domain:cli` seat (#6024), filed on the
maintainer's 2026-08-12 ruling that a handover report carries only three categories and that they
enter the skills lane as findings. ⛔ Unassigned, and ⛔ **no `domain:*` label** — this seat does not
produce routing. Addressed to the `domain:skills` seat.

## The gap, from a real card

#9737 → PR #9774. The work is finished and verified; the PR is red only on
`Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, and that redness was measured to have **no causal path**
to the diff (the failing suite is `packages/drivers/driver-sql`, whose `package.json` does not list
`@objectstack/cli` in either dependency map). A card already exists for the gate defect: #9350.

At handover there was no label that says what is true. Every option in the current state model is a
lie in a different direction:

| candidate | why it is wrong |
|---|---|
| leave `pm:dispatched` (what I did) | reads as "a dev is working on it". Nobody is. The only record that it is parked is prose in the seat post — and the seat post is rewritten at every handover, so the item survives exactly as long as each successor remembers to copy it forward |
| `pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by: #9350` | the unlock sweep would return it to `pm:queue` **for work** when #9350 closes. But the work is done; what needs redoing is a *landing check*. A successor would re-dispatch a finished card |
| `pm:on-hold` | "decided, not now" — false, and it needs a `Restart-when:` this situation cannot honestly supply |
| close it | the fix is written and unlanded |

## Why it is worth a rule rather than prose

The seat post is a body that gets rewritten wholesale. Anything whose only representation is a
paragraph in it is one careless rewrite away from a finished, verified, unlanded PR going quiet —
and an unlanded PR decays: its base moves, its merge grows conflicts, and the card looks dispatched
forever.

## What the counter-argument is

That this is rare enough not to deserve state, and that the honest handling — leave the PR open,
attach the evidence to the gate card, name it in the seat post — already worked here. That is a
real position and the skills seat may well take it. If so, the useful residue is smaller: make
"open PR whose card is `pm:dispatched` with no dev in flight" something a sweep can *see*, so the
prose is a backup rather than the only copy.

## Shape of a fix, if one is wanted

Either a state that means "work complete, landing blocked by an external card" carrying a
`Blocked-by:` whose unlock action is **re-check the PR**, not re-queue the card; or a rule that a
PR parked on a foreign gate defect must link the gate card from the PR body so the linkage is
readable from either end without the seat post.

⛔ Not proposing text. Grading, routing, and whether this becomes a rule at all are the skills
seat's call.
